elements.element: Preferred: no non-solicitation obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "neither party shall, and neither party shall permit its affiliates to, directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party" — Customer remains bound

elements.element: Fallback: restriction is mutual (binds both parties)
elements.evidence: "neither party shall, and neither party shall permit its affiliates to"

elements.element: Fallback: scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services
elements.evidence: "any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement"

elements.element: Fallback: duration is 12 months measured from the end of the individual's involvement
elements.evidence: "for a period of twelve months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement"

elements.element: Fallback: no independent restriction running for the whole Agreement term (period keyed only to involvement)
elements.evidence: "During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement" — adds a stand-alone term-long restriction beyond the involvement-keyed 12 months
"does not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at such personnel"
"or to unsolicited approaches by any such individual"
"directly solicit for employment" replaces "not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire"

elements.element: Minimality: edit no broader than needed
elements.evidence: 62-word clause replaced by a 101-word rewrite with duplicative hiring-freedom sentence

offending_extra_words: During the term of this Agreement and
or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at such personnel
and neither party is restricted from hiring any person who responds to such general advertisement or makes such an unsolicited approach
reasons: Preferred position (no non-solicit binding Customer) is not achieved; the drafter locked to fallback, so this is expected but noted.

Fallback duration is not cleanly implemented: retaining "During the term of this Agreement and" creates a restriction running for the entire term independently of any individual's involvement, broader than "12 months from the end of their involvement". Delete the term-based limb so the restriction runs only during involvement and for 12 months afterwards.

Minimality fails: a whole-clause rewrite expanding 62 to 101 words (changed-character ratio 0.753) where targeted edits to the trigger word ("hire" → "solicit for employment"), the period, and a short carve-out sentence would suffice.

The final limb ("neither party is restricted from hiring any person who responds...") duplicates the protection already given by the carve-outs and adds unnecessary words; likewise "or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at such personnel" expands the carve-out beyond the playbook's general-advertisement language.
Intent is preserved: no undefined terms, contradictions or dangling mechanics; unrelated terms untouched.
